column1: Requirement Text
The network shall provide a coverage probability of at least 95% at -98 dBm for voice and non-safety critical data.
The network shall provide a coverage probability of at least 95% at -95 dBm on ETCS level 2/3 lines for speeds ≤ 220 km/h.
The handover success rate shall be at least 99.5% under design load conditions.
Call setup times defined in the EIRENE FRS shall be achieved with authentication and ciphering enabled.
The passage of calls through external networks shall take less than 250 milliseconds.
The maximum alerting duration in the network shall not exceed 60 seconds.
The duration of DTMF tones shall be 70 ms ± 5 ms with a minimum 65 ms gap.
Direct mode equipment shall have a maximum transmit power of 1 Watt.
Direct mode equipment sensitivity shall be at least -107 dBm.
The handover break period shall not exceed 300 ms and may be reduced to 150 ms with synchronous handover.
If a Railway emergency call setup is unsuccessful, the radio shall automatically re-attempt call setup for up to 30 seconds.
The Cab radio shall withstand voltage fluctuations of ±15% without interrupting operation.
The Cab radio shall withstand 20% over-voltage for 10 seconds without interruption.
Environmental moisture condensation shall not cause malfunction.
The system shall provide recovery mechanisms to re-establish lost functional number correlation.
The network shall prevent unauthorized use of unverified functional numbers.
The system shall support confirmation of Railway emergency calls.
EIRENE mobile equipment shall operate correctly under defined coverage criteria.
The system shall comply with defined environmental testing standards.
The system shall maintain functionality under specified operational tolerances.
All Railway emergency group IDs shall remain active while powered on.
The mobile shall provide indication when GSM service is lost.
Direct mode shall only be available when GSM services are unavailable.
Re-registration shall occur when entering a new EIRENE network.
Registration confirmation shall occur before deregistration completes.
SIM cards shall contain prioritized authorized networks.
The system shall support automatic network selection.
Emergency power supply shall support at least 6 hours of operation.
Emergency call group area configuration shall be supported.
Confirmation shall be provided after emergency call clear down.
Standardized ciphering algorithms shall be used when encryption is implemented.
Mobiles shall support encryption algorithms for all roaming countries.
Closed User Groups may be employed as an additional security measure.
The system shall prevent unauthorized external calls.
Access to GSM-R networks shall require defined breakout codes.
Manual confirmation shall be required before removal of Engine Number association.
The network shall validate information during registration and deregistration.
Special access classes shall comply with GSM specifications.
SIM cards shall store authorized networks in priority order.
Confirmation messages shall use User-to-User Signalling (UUS1).
All EIRENE mobile equipment shall comply with EN 60950.
All equipment shall comply with ISO 9001.
Environmental testing shall comply with IEC 68 standards.
EMC immunity shall comply with ENV 50121 Part 4.
RF emissions shall comply with EN 301 515 transmission masks.
Direct mode shall operate at 876.0125 MHz for the common access channel.
Direct mode equipment shall operate in simplex mode.
CTCSS shall use a frequency of 203.5 Hz.
Operational radio shall conform to IP54 protection level.
National standards may supersede environmental requirements if stricter.
Environmental testing shall be conducted at accredited facilities per EN 45001.
EMC testing shall follow EN 61000-4 procedures.
Functional numbering shall use standardized USSD protocols.
Forced deregistration mechanisms shall be supported.
Validation mechanisms shall exist during registration.
Signalling shall use standardized SS7 protocols.
Routing shall use ITU-T E.164 global titles.
Maintenance access shall be considered during installation design.
SIM removal shall be restricted to maintenance staff.
Environmental test suites shall follow IEC 68 series standards.
